guarantees: schema or capability drift is quarantined until resolved
unhealthy, unobserved, restricted or digest-less sources fail closed
reconstructed backfills require an explicit reconstruction timestamp
decision digests are verified before assembly
quarantined sources remain explicitly excluded with reasons
authority, layer, time depth, legal, rights, quality, disposition and availability counts remain separate
every supplied source retains an owner role and operational disposition
no single national coverage percentage is inferred

remaining_gates: inventory every current authority and source
obtain source-specific rights and credentials where required
deploy and observe permitted connectors in controlled waves
publish reports from current national observations
complete the required beta SLO evidence period
review or remediate all operational exceptions
complete national-scale restore, correction, retirement, preservation and capacity exercises
obtain accountable approval and publish the stable operating model
satisfy the target release readiness evaluator
nonclaims: This contract does not contact endpoints, deploy connectors, preserve payloads or establish national coverage.
Repository tests do not replace elapsed operational evidence, source permission, external reproduction or accountable approval.
